newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish firm says major development in BSE detection.
newsitem.headline: Irish firm says major development in BSE detection.

text.p: Irish research company, Enfer Scientific, said on Thursday that it has made a major breakthrough in developing a test to detect BSE in beef carcasses.
Enfer said in a statement that it has developed a new post-mortem BSE testing system for the detection of disease specific prion protein PrPsc in certral nervous tissue.
It said the test has been independently validated by the department of agriculture veterinary research laboratory in Abbotstown, Ireland.
The statement said a single Enfer BSE system is able to process 1,000 beef carcasses a day with results available before the carcasses are released into the human food chain.
Ender is a privately owned Irish animal diagnostic service company.
